claims.claim: Industrial electric sewing machine is use for sewing of clothes and murtipurpuse uses
claims.evidence: Witness photos show sewing machines (white/pink with “BICCA”, and others with “Singer”, “SENCO Indigo 6”, and “NOVAMATIC NM 868A”), but do not show a working test or confirm industrial/multipurpose capability.

risks.risk: Unclear which exact machine is for sale (photos show multiple different brands/models: BICCA, Singer, SENCO Indigo 6, NOVAMATIC NM 868A). This can cause paying for the wrong unit.
risks.proof: A single clear photo of the exact machine being sold showing the full brand/model label (one machine only), plus a close-up of the serial/model plate if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case: unknown exact model and assume not guaranteed to match what’s shown; treat as higher risk/possibly non-matching unit.

risks.risk: Not proven working: no stitching test, motor run, or thread tension check shown.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine running on power and performing a straight stitch on fabric (show feed moving, needle cycling, and even stitches).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or untested (worst-case), since functionality is not demonstrated.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/consumables (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual) not shown.
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing all included parts/accessories (feet, bobbins, needles, power cable, manual) with counts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories; assume missing common parts.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: rust, cracks, missing parts, worn feed dogs, or damaged needle/presser foot area.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of needle area, presser foot, feed dogs, underside/hinges, and any visible damage (plus a photo of the power inlet).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worn/possibly damaged cosmetically or mechanically (worst-case) because condition details aren’t shown.

risks.risk: Power/voltage compatibility for Lagos not confirmed (whether it runs on local current).
risks.proof: A video showing it powered on and running (with the power indicator/light if any) in the seller’s location.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified for local power compatibility; assume it may not run correctly.

proof_requests: Confirm which single machine is for sale (one brand/model only) and send one clear photo showing the full brand/model label.
Send a short video of the machine running and stitching on fabric (straight stitch) showing needle movement and feed.
Show all included accessories laid out (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual) with counts.
Send close-ups of needle area, presser foot, feed dogs, and any visible damage/rust/cracks.
Show it powering on and running in Lagos current (video clip).
response.reason: The witness confirms sewing machines and visible brand/model markings, but the exact unit for sale is ambiguous (multiple brands/models shown) and there is no proof it works or what accessories/condition are included. Without these, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
